text:
Anika (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A. Thanks for the sharp questions — dropping clarifications, links to the slides, and owners for the outstanding asks. Recording + slides: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-deck (org-only).

Raj (Head of Sales): Can we confirm which customers will be invited to the Dedicated pilot and the selection criteria? A few enterprise deals asked for an ETA.

Carlos (Platform Eng): Pilot invites: we'll prioritize existing Dedicated beta customers + three enterprise accounts flagged by sales. Criteria: must have >100M tokens/month projected, willingness to share perf metrics, and legal cleared for data handling.

Zoe (Data Scientist): For Optimize (cost/perf toolkit) demo: will pilot customers get early access to the quantization recommendations? We want to show expected cost delta on their workloads.

Anika (CEO): Yes, Optimize early access is part of the pilot. Product will prep a short demo using anonymized sample workloads.

Maya (Legal): Heads-up: Private deployment contracts need an addendum for KMS/HSM usage and SOC-type audit rights. Sales, please send me the two pilot contract templates and I'll draft the addendum.

Raj (Head of Sales): Will do. I'll send templates to Maya by EOD 2026-03-24.

Carlos (Platform Eng): Ops notes: Dedicated pilot infra will run in us-west-2 & eu-west-1. We'll enable detailed telemetry for pilot customers (token-level metrics + route-level SLOs). Need sign-off on telemetry retention from privacy.

Maya (Legal): Telemetry retention: default 90 days for pilot data unless customer requests longer and signs the addendum. We'll advise sales on opt-ins.

Zoe (Data Scientist): Can we get sample datasets or token distributions from sales for the demo? We need realistic seq-len and prompt mix to estimate batching/cost wins.

Raj (Head of Sales): I'll ask the three pilot accounts to provide sample traffic snapshots (anonymized) and get back in 2 weeks.

recorder-bot: Note saved to "AH followups/2026-03-23/1934721111".

Anika (CEO): Action items summary below. I'll check progress in next week's leadership sync. Please add JIRA links where applicable.

Action items:
- Raj (Head of Sales) -> send pilot customer list + contract templates to Maya by 2026-03-24 (#JIRA-3001)
- Maya (Legal) -> draft KMS/audit addendum and telemetry retention guidance due 2026-03-30 (#JIRA-3002)
- Carlos (Platform Eng) -> enable pilot telemetry in us-west-2 & eu-west-1, add retention config UI stub (#JIRA-3003) due 2026-04-06
- Zoe (Data Scientist) -> prepare Optimize demo using anonymized sample traffic; include expected cost delta slides due 2026-04-08 (#JIRA-3004)
- Product (TBD) -> create early-access flow for Optimize in Console; coordinate with infra for flags due 2026-04-12 (#JIRA-3005)

Raj (Head of Sales): Also propose a short external FAQ for pilot customers around data privacy, telemetry, and support levels. I can draft a first pass.

Maya (Legal): I'll review the FAQ draft and flag any compliance wording.

Carlos (Platform Eng): Small technical note: pilot will use optimized kernels for 8-bit quantization by default; we'll expose an opt-out if customers need full-fp. Posting a short tech note to #eng-runtime.

Zoe (Data Scientist): Perfect. That helps set demo expectations.

Anika (CEO): Final ask: if anyone can't meet the dates above, flag here by 2026-03-26 so we can re-prioritize. Thanks again — great momentum. :sparkles:
